notes: Skips tsconfig.json, vitest.config.ts, and the typecheck and test scripts, because the project is plain JavaScript and Python with no TypeScript or tests.
Does not install typescript, vite, vitest, or @types/node, because nothing in the project uses them.
Keeps the build, dev, and fix scripts, because the project builds with bin/build, serves with wrangler dev, and the README documents pnpm fix.
Keeps pnpm 12.14.0 in packageManager, because it is newer than the recipe's pnpm and the lockfile is written by it.
Allows workerd to run build scripts in pnpm-workspace.yaml, because wrangler needs it.
Ignores .wrangler, .DS_Store, squashfs-root, and build in .gitignore, for wrangler state, the extracted Bambu Studio AppImage, and the release downloads.
Runs pnpm check from the Deploy workflow instead of the ci recipe's workflow, because that workflow already checks every pull request and push before building.
